name: Hoshi o Sagashite...
source:
Hoshi o Sagashite is a sci-fi text-adventure game for the Sega Mark III. It begins when the main character takes a vacation to visit his girlfriend and buys her an egg as a present. The egg hatches into a creature called a "Mio". You must discover what a Mio is, how to care for it.

[From: [url=http://projects.mattsmessyroom.com/searchingthestars/]Matt's Messy Room[/url]]
translation:
《寻找星星…》是世嘉Mark III平台的一款科幻文字冒险游戏。故事开始时，主人公休假前去探望女友，并买下一颗蛋作为礼物。蛋里孵出一种名叫"Mio"的生物。你必须查明Mio究竟是什么，以及该如何照顾它。

[摘自：[url=http://projects.mattsmessyroom.com/searchingthestars/]Matt's Messy Room[/url]]
